prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in League City, Texas. I had a green light going straight.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car came from my right side and went through the red. It hit the passenger side of my car. I didn't have time to brake.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you hit anything else, or did your airbags deploy?

A: The driver's side airbag came out. My head didn't hit the window, but my right knee hit the lower dash pretty hard.

Q: Did you get medical attention at the scene?

A: An ambulance came and checked me out. I was taken to urgent care later that day because the knee kept swelling.

Q: What symptoms are you having with the knee now?

A: It's painful when I bend it or put weight on it. It locks sometimes, and I'm using a brace right now. I've been told I might need an MRI.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: Yes, I've had to take some time off. I'm waiting on paperwork from my employer about the exact amount.

Q: Did you have any knee problems before the collision?

A: No, nothing like this. I played sports in school, but my knee had never given me trouble.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was not at fault. I was following the signals the whole time.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
